title: Mirror decode_record body does not exercise TrailingBytes path
raw_evidence: The #[verifier::external] decode_record body at lines 686-733 folds all header-payload validation outcomes into header_ok:bool and returns SpecJournalError::PayloadTooLarge as a representative failure. The expected_payload_end: u32 parameter is taken but unused in the body. The new Err(SpecJournalError::TrailingBytes { trailing }) arm exists only in the bridge contract at verification/verus/vb-vzcuf-PS-003.rs:439-452, not in the mirror body.
required_fix: No fix required. The body is #[verifier::external] (opaque to Verus); the assume_specification bridge REPLACES the body for verification. The bridge contract enumerates the TrailingBytes arm with the postconditions header_ok, (bytes.len() as u32) > expected_payload_end, trailing == (bytes.len() as u32) - expected_payload_end, trailing > 0, !decode_ok. The new wrapper_decode_record_trailing_bytes (line 1130-1235) has requires: (bytes.len() as u32) > expected_payload_end, !decode_ok so the bridge's postcondition is discharged against a concrete call site. Verus verifies 25/25 proofs. Kani H6 provides the secondary mechanical check on the production ordering.

title: TrailingBytes.trailing type differs between spec (u32) and production (usize)
raw_evidence: SpecJournalError::TrailingBytes at line 403 declares trailing: u32; production JournalError::TrailingBytes per contract.md §4.1 line 54 declares trailing: usize. The bridge contract uses u32 arithmetic (e.g. trailing == (bytes.len() as u32) - expected_payload_end) and the Verus mirror functions take u32 throughout (matching existing variants like BadMagic { found: u32 }).
required_fix: No fix required. Verus modeling uses u32 for spec arithmetic; production runtime uses usize. Values agree for any platform where usize is 32 bits and for any input where bytes.len() - payload_end < 2^32 (the codec's payload-length cap constrains the slice size). Documented in the proof-writer's report §3 and TL-006.
